title: Syntagma sacrae theologiae (Liber I Cap. 1 densify complete)
author: Ludwig Crocius
edition: Syntagma sacrae theologiae (Bremen: Berthold Villerian, 1636). VD17 14:684303C. SLUB id335860389. Liber I Cap. 1 De Theologiae definitione densify COMPLETE PHYS 121–mid-152.
blurb: Ludwig Crocius — Liber I Cap. 1 On the definition of theology from the 1636 Bremen Latin, densify COMPLETE (definition, name-scholion, practical-habit proofs and objections, Aristotle analogy, subject and end, life of God through Cap. 1 close before Cap. 2). Cap. 2–11 already complete; Liber I closed; Liber II next PHYS 331.
era_note: Crocius wrote in the early seventeenth century as Reformed professor at the illustrious school of Bremen. This is not a patristic work. It is a public-domain Latin Reformed retrieval on the same Fathers-site pipeline. The 1636 Villerian folio is Public Domain Mark 1.0. Do not treat the site as ante-Nicene only.
first_english_note: First English densify COMPLETE of Liber I Cap. 1 from locked 1636 Bremen Latin (tip PHYS 121–128 preserved; remainder PHYS 128 mid–152).

text_history.method: English follows the locked 1636 Bremen Latin of Liber I Cap. 1 COMPLETE (definition through Cap. 1 close before CAPUT SECUNDUM). Tip secs 1–2 preserved; remainder densified from SLUB Dresden page images PHYS 121–mid-152 via tesseract lat + Apple Vision OCR. No modern English was copied.
